documentation.rationale: Identity and terms are covered: the VIN matches the decode, the price is itemised as $24,998 with no dealer fees, and the CARFAX shows a guaranteed clean title, one owner and no reported accidents. Maintenance evidence is strong in CARFAX form: 18 dealer service entries, including a dated brake fluid flush and battery. Missing: actual invoices, a recall closure printout, and photos of the at-risk areas (underside, footwells, targa drains, tire DOT dates).

condition.rationale: The photos show straight, clean paint, unmarked-looking factory wheels at this resolution, and a tidy auburn interior with no obvious wear. Recent documented age items help: brake fluid and battery 11/2025, oil 08/2026. There is no PPI and no underside, engine bay or roof-cycling evidence, and the car spent seven years in the MD/DE salt belt.

price_value.rationale: The $24,998 ask sits just above the $22,286-$24,689 fair-value band and about 8% above its $23,080 mid. No known-work items are established. It matches the Shreveport 2018 RF GT ask and is below the 2021 RF GT ask at $27,995.

mission_fit.rationale: The car is a manual, an ND2 with the better engine, from a reliable low-maintenance model, and very resellable inside 6-24 months. It suits the coast roads. It sits above the $10-19k ideal band but under the $27,000 ceiling, and it is available now from a dealer.

logistics.rationale: The car is 2,427 miles away in Alexandria VA. Being a dealer retail car, an independent PPI before money moves should be arrangeable, but access is not yet confirmed. The fly-out and long drive home are straightforward cost items. CA registration and smog are feasible for a clean-title 2019.

emotional_spec_fit.rationale: Several desirable traits come together: ND2 181 hp engine, 6-speed manual, RF roof, GT-S package with LSD and Bilstein dampers, and the strong-money Machine Gray over Auburn Nappa combination. It is stock and single-owner.

evidence.mission_note: This is a manual ND2 RF with documented single-owner dealer maintenance, so it squarely fits the enthusiast-bridge brief: reliable, engaging and easy to resell. Its only stretch is a price above the ideal band, though still under the $27,000 ceiling.
evidence.rationale: The CARFAX establishes one personal owner from 2019 to 2026 and a guaranteed clean title. It shows a steady mileage trail ending at the 34,926 mi visible in the odometer photo, and 18 service entries at Preston Mazda, including regular oil changes, a brake fluid flush and a battery replacement on 11/22/2025. The photos show a stock-looking Machine Gray GT-S RF with a manual shifter and a tidy Auburn interior. Nothing in the listing, photos or report states a fault. Open items: there is no completion entry for the 21V875 fuel-pump or 24V695 airbag recalls, and no reported entry for MT fluid, diff fluid or coolant. The underside, footwells, roof operation and tire DOT dates are not examined here, which matters after seven Mid-Atlantic winters. The 2019 build date removes the early ND1 gearbox concern. At $24,998 the ask sits just above the $22,286-$24,689 fair-value band, and no known-work items are established.
evidence.next_action: Email BMW of Alexandria for a Mazda recall-closure printout, tire DOT and underside photos, and written agreement to an independent PPI in the Alexandria area before any deposit.
